package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
)

var lastName string

// byeHandler keeps the name in a package-level variable, which is a data race.
func byeHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	lastName = r.URL.Query().Get("name")
	if lastName == "" {
		lastName = "world"
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(w, "Goodbye, %s!", lastName)
}
